title: The free energy principle is in tension with enaction

statements.text: Claims that the free energy principle and enaction are natural partners rest on misreadings, such as confusing a system’s organization with its structure and conflating self-distinction in operationally closed systems with Markov blankets. The principle’s assumption of a time-invariant non-equilibrium steady state contradicts the historicity of sense-making.
